blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Visayas grid was placed under yellow alert from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. on Tuesday due to the unavailability of several power plants and reduced capacity of others, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) said. The grid had about 2,504 megawatts (MW) of available capacity against an expected peak demand of 2,419 MW, leaving it short of the required contingency reserve, the NGCP said.
